'''The Golden Plains'''{{co|50|33|Mulgore}} are a large basin surrounding [[Thunder Bluff]] on the southeast. These plains are one of the most treasured parts of the [[tauren]] homeland, and are one of the tauren people's favorite hunting grounds. Large numbers of [[kodo]] congregate here, and it is said that the famous [[Arra'chea]] also dwells in the shifting green sea of grass.
